title: Palamedes
summary: Palamedes is a Krono-Titan used by White, one of the Nimue Casterwill's guardians. Dressed in a red cape, splintered golder armor and a shoulder plate over his right shoulder, Palamedes is a skilled warrior who wields a battle axe in combat. He is the brother of Mallory's Titan, Pellinore.

full_text:
Palamedes is a Krono-Titan used by White, one of the Nimue Casterwill's guardians. Dressed in a red cape, splintered golder armor and a shoulder plate over his right shoulder, Palamedes is a skilled warrior who wields a battle axe in combat. He is the brother of Mallory's Titan, Pellinore.

== History ==
Palamedes was summoned by White to attack Dante Vale's team when they entered the Crystal Caves. He fought against Lok Lambert's Lindorm and Zhalia Moon's Gareon. Despite Lindorm defeating him and sending him back to his Amulet, Palamedes was immediately revived by White's Newlife power and re-invoked. After sending Zhalia Moon's Gareon back to its Amulet, he went on to surround the team with White and Mallory. At that moment, Nimue and Sophie Casterwill arrived, White and Mallory were ordered by Nimue to stand down, and Palamedes was called back to his Amulet. [Cave of the Casterwills]

== Abilities ==
Palamedes uses an axe in combat in contrast to his brother Pellinore's sword. He swings it with great power, enough to cause significant damage to whatever it impacts. [Cave of the Casterwills] Palamedes is also quick to react and capitalize on opportunities to strike an enemy when their guard is down. [Cave of the Casterwills]
